annotations.title: Resolve a NSW street address to its official form and latitude/longitude.

description: Resolve a NSW street address to its official form and latitude/longitude. Matches the address against the NSW address register and returns matched_address, lat and lng. Use it to check an address before nsw_da_search_nearby_applications, nsw_cdc_search_nearby_applications or nsw_property_get_planning_report, which accept the same address or the returned lat and lng. An ambiguous address returns an error with suggested matches; an unknown one returns address_not_found. Free, no payment needed. Source: NSW Spatial Services, CC BY 4.0.

address.description: Street number, street and suburb; a trailing state and postcode are accepted and ignored (e.g. 10 Brigalow Ave, Casula NSW 2170)

name: nsw_da_resolve_address

attribution.description: Source attribution; keep it when presenting the data

text.description: Attribution text to show alongside the data

data.description: Result: a list of applications for search and nearby tools, one record or summary object otherwise
